opinion.headline: An old geopolitical distortion corrected
opinion.hook: The United Nations has adopted the Equal Earth projection, correcting centuries of map distortion.
opinion.summary: This new projection restores proportional accuracy, unlike the Mercator projection's historical inaccuracies. Africa and Latin America regain their true sizes, while Europe appears scaled appropriately. This change aims to counter colonial hierarchies and reshape global perceptions of continents. The UN's move emphasizes the profound impact of representation on dignity and power.
